why: The stimuli generator yields ZERO usable samples for this grammar on the gate's bounded depth ladder: its ~16-level precedence chain needs max_depth ≳ 30 to reach a leaf, and the only generating depth window (~32) emits pathologically huge, hang-adjacent expressions (tool-established via the CLI generation sweep). This hand-authored corpus exercises every construct directly, kept small so the no-memo interpreter stays fast: both literal kinds (incl. underscores, every based radix b/o/d/h, signed), plain / dotted / package-qualified identifiers, all four unary ops (incl. nesting), every binary op at each of the 10 precedence levels + multi-term chains + mixed precedence, ternary (incl. nesting), parentheses, whitespace / trivia variety, and near-miss rejects (both sides must agree on the reject too). INPUTS only: the differential still compares the interpreter against the authoritative generated parser, which supplies the verdict + typed AST.
